hints.title: Parity State Tracking
hints.text: The penalty depends only on whether the last visited number was even or odd.

hints.title: Two-State Maintenance
hints.text: Keep two variables tracking the maximum score ending on an even value and on an odd value.

hints.title: State Transition
hints.text: At each step, transitioning from the opposite parity incurs a penalty of x, while matching parity incurs no penalty.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Dynamic programming state machine tracking maximum scores for even and odd endings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all possible subsequences starting at index 0 takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) time and O(1) space tracking the two parity scores.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 64-bit integers to prevent numeric overflow with cumulative sums.
